title: 第一卷 第5章 将军之女三皇子崩溃了第一卷 第6章 父皇的PUA 大将军被忽悠瘸了
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
轰！
圣旨的内容，如同一道九天惊雷，在赵辰安、赵辰宇和乌若雪三人的脑海中同时炸响！
三皇子赵辰宇猛地抬头，整个人都傻了。
赵辰安则是在最初的震惊之后，心中瞬间掀起了滔天巨浪！
卧槽！
父皇，您这执行力，不去当996卷王真是可惜了！
我前脚刚告诉你“娶妻资质越高，奖励越丰厚”
，你后脚就把大将军的女儿给我送过来了？
这一刻，赵辰安彻底明白了。
这不是惩罚，也不是什么随机的恩赐。
这是试探！
是父皇赵道霆，对他那个“上古传承”
的第一次，也是最直接的一次投资和测试！
魏公公合上圣旨，居高临下地看着跪在最前方的赵辰安，面无表情。
“十六皇子，接旨吧。”
赵辰安缓缓抬起双手，动作沉稳而标准，没有一丝一毫的颤抖。
“儿臣，谢父皇隆恩。”
他恭敬地从魏公公手中接过了那卷足以改变无数人命运的明黄色卷轴。
入手，微沉。
魏公公那张布满褶子的老脸，看不出任何情绪。

他只是意味深长地瞥了一眼旁边已经彻底石化的三皇子赵辰宇。
那浑浊的眸子里，像是有几分怜悯，又像是有几分嘲弄。
随即，他一甩拂尘，转身便走，没有多说一个字。
一队禁军甲胄铿锵，紧随其后，很快便消失在了府门之外。
人走了，但那道圣旨带来的恐怖压力，却依然笼罩着整个前厅。
“不……不可能……”
死寂之中，一个破碎的、充满着荒谬与不解的喃喃自语响起。
赵辰宇还跪在地上，整个人像是被抽走了骨头，瘫软在那里。
他缓缓抬起头，布满血丝的双目死死盯着赵辰安手中的圣旨，仿佛要将它看穿。
李青鸾……
赐给老十六当侧妃？
七日后完婚？
每一个字，都像是一柄烧红的铁锤，狠狠砸在他的心上。
他猛地从地上爬起来，因为动作太急，一个踉跄差点摔倒。
“十六弟……”
赵辰宇冲到赵辰安面前，一把揪住他的衣领，嘶哑地质问：
“是你！
content_en:
boom!
The contents of the imperial edict were like thunder from the sky, exploding in the minds of Zhao Chenan, Zhao Chenyu and Wu Ruoxue at the same time!
The third prince, Zhao Chenyu, suddenly raised his head and was stunned.
Zhao Chenan, after the initial shock, instantly felt a huge wave in his heart!
Damn it!
Father, with your execution ability, it would be a pity not to be the King of Volume 996!
I just told you, "The higher the qualifications for marrying a wife, the more generous the reward will be."
, you just sent me the general’s daughter?
At this moment, Zhao Chenan completely understood.
This is not a punishment, nor is it some random gift.
This is a temptation!
It was his father, Zhao Daoting, who was interested in his "ancient inheritance"
The first and most direct investment and test!
Eunuch Wei closed the imperial edict and looked down at Zhao Chenan who was kneeling at the front with an expressionless face.
"Sixteenth Prince, accept the order."
Zhao Chenan slowly raised his hands, his movements steady and standard, without any trembling.
"My son, thank you father for your kindness."
He respectfully took the bright yellow scroll from Eunuch Wei's hand, which could change the fate of countless people.
Started, slightly sinking.
Eunuch Wei's old wrinkled face showed no emotion.
He just glanced meaningfully at the third prince Zhao Chenyu who was completely petrified next to him.
There seemed to be a bit of pity and a bit of ridicule in those cloudy eyes.
Immediately, he flicked the fly whisk, turned around and left without saying a word.
A group of Forbidden Army soldiers with clanging armor followed closely behind and soon disappeared outside the gate of the mansion.
The person left, but the terrifying pressure brought by the imperial edict still enveloped the entire front hall.
"No...impossible..."
In the dead silence, a broken murmur filled with absurdity and incomprehension sounded.
Zhao Chenyu was still kneeling on the ground, his whole body seemed to have had his bones taken away, and he was paralyzed there.
He slowly raised his head, his bloodshot eyes staring intently at the imperial edict in Zhao Chenan's hand, as if he wanted to see through it.
Li Qingluan...
Giving Lao Shiliu the title of concubine?
Getting married in seven days?
Every word was like a red-hot hammer hitting his heart.
He suddenly got up from the ground, staggering and almost falling because he moved too quickly.
"Sixteenth brother..."
Zhao Chenyu rushed to Zhao Chenan, grabbed him by the collar, and asked hoarsely:
"It's you!
